name: ARKSurvivalAscended
description: `ich777` no longer supports ARK: Survival Ascended, so this is an alternative Unraid template that uses the `acekorneya/asa_server` image. This Docker will download and install ARK: Survival Ascended Dedicated Server and run it (Normal server startup of ARK can take a long time!). ATTENTION: First Startup can take very long since it downloads the gameserver files! Update Notice: Simply restart the container if a newer version of the game is available.
